content.text: {"id": "mm7047a4", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "During September–December 2020 (weeks 35–52), the numbers of specimens tested among patients receiving and not receiving MOUD were 43% and 13% lower"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "the percentage testing positive approximately doubled by the end of 2019 (weeks 51–52) to 26.7%"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "count/rate", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "The numbers of specimens tested among patients receiving and not receiving MOUD declined 65% and 72%, respectively"}]}, {"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "the percentage testing positive approximately doubled by the end of 2019 (weeks 51–52) to 26.7%"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Among the 373,946 included specimens, 57,749 (15.4%) were from patients receiving MOUD."}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "levels considerably lower than the corresponding period during 2019"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Among patients not receiving MOUD, the prevalence of positive nonprescribed fentanyl test results did not increase significantly"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "surveillance/descriptive", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "clinical drug monitoring of urine specimens from patients residing in all U.S. states and the District of Columbia were tested"}]}, {"v": "before/after or trend", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "compared with the same weeks in 2019"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "A positive test result for nonprescribed fentanyl was defined as detection of norfentanyl (major fentanyl metabolite) or fentanyl not listed as prescribed."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Among 427,915 specimens, 53,969 (12.6%) from patients whose opioid use disorder medication status was inconclusive were excluded from the analyses."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "SAS Studio (version 3.6; SAS Institute) was used to conduct all analyses."}], "confidence": "medium", "uncertain_fields": []}
